display.purpose: Hero headlines and full-viewport section titles only. Leading 0.90 is intentional — the visual mass of tight stacked lines reads as a single stamped nameplate.

headline.purpose: Section headers and page titles. Distinct from display by weight (700 vs 800) and leading (1.1 vs 0.90).

title.purpose: Card headers, feature names, sub-section labels.

body.purpose: All running prose. Max 65–75ch line length.

label.purpose: Section divider text, stat labels, certification metadata. Uppercase only for ≤4-word identifiers.

shadows.name: warm-sm
shadows.purpose: Subtle hover lift for small interactive elements.

shadows.name: warm-lg
shadows.purpose: Card hover elevation — appears only on hover, never at rest.

shadows.name: cta-red-glow
shadows.purpose: Resting glow beneath red CTA buttons.

shadows.name: cta-red-glow-hover
shadows.purpose: Deepened red glow on button hover.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: All content reveals and nav underline slides. Exponential out.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: State transitions (color, border, shadow). Global transition default.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Color and border state changes. The global transition-duration.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Content fade-up reveals on scroll entry.

motion.name: stagger-children
motion.purpose: Stagger delay between sibling items in reveal sequences.

breakpoints.name: max-content

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Ghost Button

components.name: Nav CTA Button

components.css: .ds-nav-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 16px; height: 36px; background: #E74C3C; color: #fff; font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #C0392B; transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E74C3C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card

components.html:
uPVC Casement Window

Multi-chamber profiles engineered for the UAE climate. Thermal performance, acoustic attenuation, and impact resistance in a single extrusion.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid #E4E2DC; padding: 32px; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: #C0C6CA; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(45, 41, 38, 0.12); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1A1A1A; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: #3D3A37; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 52px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #3D3A37; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-nav-underline { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: #E74C3C; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover .ds-nav-underline { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E74C3C; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The visual system takes its logic from the product itself. Extruded aluminum profiles have a direction: horizontal or vertical, never diagonal. Their tolerances are tight. Their corners are sharp because the extrusion die doesn't round. The silver is not a decorative choice — it is the material.

The three-tier surface structure (void → off-white → white) mirrors the product's own material logic: raw dark substrate, treated surface, finished face. The silver system carries the material's identity. The red CTA is the anodized accent stripe on an otherwise bare metal surface — singular, deliberate, unmistakable.

Warmth in this system does not come from the UI. It comes from the interior photography: sunlight through glazing, timber floors seen through large-format windows, the glow of a lit residence at dusk. The UI is the frame. The photography is the view.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp corners throughout — 0px radius on all interactive elements; 2px on cards as minimum structural rounding only
Two-axis discipline — lines, dividers, and layout rules run horizontally or vertically; no diagonal accents
One accent color — brand red on ≤10% of any screen surface
Silver as material — the neutral system reads as the metal itself, not as gray
Typography in a single family — Cairo carries both Arabic and Latin; weight and scale create all hierarchy
Motion serves the frame — transitions reveal content; they do not animate the frame itself

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Brand red (#E74C3C) occupies ≤10% of any given screen surface at any time. Its rarity is the point. If more than one element on a screen is red, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Warmth-In-UI Rule
rules.body: Warmth is a photography responsibility, not a UI responsibility. Do not add tinted warm overlays, amber glows, or warm-hued gradients to UI elements. The surfaces are industrial neutrals. The photographs are warm.

rules.name: The Material Rule
rules.body: Silver (#C0C6CA) is the material, not a gray default. Never use a generic CSS gray as a substitute; reach for a named silver token.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Cairo is the only typeface on this site. Adding a second family breaks the Arabic-Latin parity. Weight and scale contrast create all hierarchy.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Display headings use line-height: 0.90. This is intentional. The visual mass of a tight stacked headline is the design. Do not fix it to 1.2.

rules.name: The Frame Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. The UI is the frame; shadows are not the default. Never add a shadow to a card at rest — only on hover, as a response to user intent.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: All box-shadow values use rgba(45, 41, 38, x) as the shadow color. The value rgba(0, 0, 0, x) is banned.

dos: Do use border-radius: 0px on all buttons, inputs, and tags.
Do keep shadows warm: rgba(45, 41, 38, x). Swap rgba(0, 0, 0, x) for the warm equivalent every time.
Do keep brand red at ≤10% of any screen surface. One primary CTA per viewport.
Do force dir="ltr" on numerals and codes rendered inside an Arabic (dir="rtl") context.
Do let photography carry warmth. The UI surfaces are industrial neutrals.
Do apply text-wrap: balance on h1–h3 elements.
Do use gold (#C9A84C) only on certification icons and award badges.
Do test every component in both LTR (English) and RTL (Arabic) before shipping.
donts: Don't add blue or any blue derivative to any element, shadow, or border.
Don't use rgba(0,0,0,x) in any box-shadow.
Don't round button corners. Not even 4px.
Don't use ornamental Arabic calligraphic patterns, geometric Islamic tile patterns, or traditional decorative borders.
Don't put a shadow on a card at rest. Only hover reveals the shadow.
Don't use gold (#C9A84C) as a general accent or hover color.
Don't add diagonal lines, rotated shapes, or angled decorative elements.
